what: a bent tube (circles r 30 lofted through 5 sections along an R100 arc turning 60 degrees) with a bore (r 18, sections running 5 mm of arc past both ends) cut out of it: a hollow elbow ("no result" for some section counts, not their neighbours)
method: the wall of a bent tube is a ring section turned about the bend axis, its centre at radius 100: Pappus V = pi (30^2 - 18^2) * 100 * theta with theta = 60 degrees = 189496.4. The bore overshoots both ends along the same arc, so the cut opens the ends and leaves exactly the wall.
